Monologue: And so the hounds start to lose their sheep.
One-by-one, they stray. Into the jaws of wolves who look soft and fleecy.
Svetka admires the mindless obedience of the flock. Those you refuse to serve won't just be jailed. Execution is her method of culling the sickness.
Just one rotten apple spoils the rest; one must select fine fruit to dine on.
Fate has watched you for eternity, little lamb. How I wish I could reach out and touch your wool.
Goodnight, sweet thing. I will see you soon.
